summary.coverage_denominator: issuer supply at issuer source timestamp

onchain_bucket_vs_attested.note: Ethena's onchain-wallet bucket vs the wallets we read. The aligned pair is the meaningful one: taken days apart, it measures SCOPE — what the attested bucket counts that our wallet read does not — rather than a month of drift. The difference is what the custody residual absorbs, so it is stated here rather than left unnamed.

latest_content_access.basis: Accepted public issuer article/document review; not independent authenticity or current assurance

ceffu_scope.note: Different custody/account perimeters and update timing; no automatic currency equivalence, substitution or additive assets.

reconciliation.meaning: Arithmetic differences across statement perimeters and rounded issuer inputs, not verified missing funds, loss or proven rounding.

issuer_headline.basis: Historical issuer-reported rounded amounts; not independent current coverage.

roster.basis: Historical disclosure only; matching membership does not clear composition or ownership.

limitations: Custodian/provider assertions are not independently authenticated signatures or a complete financial audit.
Copper includes unsettled amounts; Kraken includes unsettled/in-transit exceptions.
Loan collateral and its custody subletters secure principal; never count both as independent backing.
Ripple Prime is account equity including open-trade equity, not off-exchange custody.
Live ownership, encumbrance, liabilities, provider balances and current reserve composition remain unverified.

anchorage_loan.label: Anchorage lending principal
anchorage_loan.caveat: Excluded from Anchorage custody; secured loan claim, not cash.

falconx_loan.label: FalconX SPV lending principal
falconx_loan.caveat: Loan claim, not direct Ethena cash; do not add secured collateral and principal as separate backing

risk_flags.message: 1 reserve account(s) disclosed by the attestation are not in the FarmTracker export (0xd7fcade52afb60fbf0e1e5f72a683f43820f56a0) — their balances are not in our on-chain read. How much of the on-chain bucket difference they account for is not measured

notes.custody_vs_total: Mixed-clock wallet/custodian subsets, not a full balance sheet; allocation unknown. Do not sum into issuer backing.
notes.defi_pie_scope: defi_protocol_breakdown is a drill-down of the Coinbase Onchain Wallets custody slice, not of total backing — do not double-count.
notes.wallet_data_cadence: Wallet subset retains FarmTracker daily clock. Issuer status, composition, positions, chain state and cached daily metrics have separate clocks in source_metadata.
notes.coinbase_wallets_naming: 'coinbase_wallets' and the 'Coinbase Onchain Wallets' custody slice keep Ethena's own label for this bucket, which files 14 accounts under it — 12 EVM plus 2 Solana, at least one of them Bitwise/Jupiter Lend rather than Coinbase custody. Totalling this as Coinbase-the-custodian overstates it. The name is kept so figures stay traceable to the attestation; read it as onchain wallets.
